decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's established consumer health knowledge and pharmacy channels, so the firm can interpret market feedback and adjust the line instead of withdrawing it.
The skin and hair supplement sits within the firm's core supplement expertise, so the firm can refine it from experience even though there is no recent web evidence about it.
As an extension of the established Trivital line, the joint product draws on deep related knowledge in formulation, regulation and marketing, which favours continued improvement over withdrawal.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche concept with low visibility, but post-2020 demand for immune products and its fit with the firm's supplement know-how make keeping it the more likely choice.

The OTC triptan is distant from the firm's supplement focus, yet the firm's pharmaceutical development and regulatory capabilities give it enough related knowledge to assimilate market feedback, so it is kept despite a substantial risk of withdrawal.
